extensions.name: BHASM
extensions.description: Opencode-style agent + typed tools + skills. Local-first, offline, reversible — it only ever proposes PatchOps.
extensions.author: CLARO

extensions.name: CLARO Terminal
extensions.description: ConPTY bridge over claro:term:* — spawn a shell or a built EXE by argv, and stream its stdout live into the terminal feed. Offline, Windows-native, no node-pty.
extensions.author: CLARO

extensions.name: Claro Design System
extensions.description: Prefer compact, reversible UI patterns for Claro projects. Button variants, card patterns, spacing, typography conventions.
extensions.author: CLARO

extensions.name: Git Tools
extensions.description: Git status, log, diff, commit, push from the terminal toolbar. Branch status in statusbar.
extensions.author: CLARO

extensions.name: Debug Tools
extensions.description: Breakpoints, variable inspection, console.log inspection, debugger statement support in Monaco.
extensions.author: CLARO
